rationale: Investigate and explicitly classify historical failures; add post-verdict evidence without changing product code, comparison/timing limits, capture inputs or baseline acceptance. This is diagnostic delivery, not a claim to have repaired unresolved raster/Cancel drift.

summary.ru: Диагностика нестабильных CI-проверок сохраняет геометрию кадра и различия состояния после отказа без ослабления проверок.
summary.en: Flaky-check diagnostics retain post-capture geometry and post-failure state differences without weakening the original oracles.
